units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:7-8">Num. R. s. 2</cite> <he>לכל נשיא ונשיא מ׳ וצבע</he> for each prince a flag of a different color.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:7">Ib.</cite> <he>צבע מ׳</he> the color of the flag; a. fr.—[Pl. <he>מַפּוֹת</he>. Mekh. B’shall. s. 2, v. <cite ref="M01805"><he>מְנָפָה</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: (cmp. Lat. mappa, of Punic origin) napkin, towel.

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:12">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 10:3:3">Y. Erub. X, 26ᵇ</cite> top <he>ספר שאין עליו מ׳</he> a scroll which is not bandaged (so that the writing is partly exposed).
